Portugal reporting plugin output guide for Apex Dragon Power Combo™ 105170

  This is the guide for Apex Dragon Power Combo™

* Reporting string constants and format   
  * Add string format e.g.:   
    ▪ \#R \- specifies the start of the win line (retribution line)   
    ▪ \#MT \- win multiplier   
    ▪ \#MG \- win line payout   
    ▪ \#MV \- total wager   
    ▪ Each line is separated by character '\#' and symbols are separated by ';'.

* Game Features  
  * Bonus Spins

* Bet amount  
  * \#MV\#1\#MT\#1\#MG\#0\#  
      
    MV\#1\# defines that the bet is 1  
    MT\#1\# defines that the multiplier is 1  
    MG\#0\# defines that the win was 0

    

# 1\. Normal Spin, No Win.

0:a;p;k;d;j\#a;j;g;a;j\#a;o;g;a;e\#MV\#100\#MT\#1\#MG\#0\# 

0: Defines the first event (Base Game)  
a;p;k;d;j\#a;j;g;a;j\#a;o;g;a;e: Are the symbols which landed split into rows by the \# sign.

### 1.1 No Win

MV\#100\#MT\#1\#MG\#0\#

MV\#100 represents the wager amount of 100\.  
MT\#1 is the multiplier of 1\.  
MG\#0 indicates the win amount of 0\.

# 2\. Normal Spin, multiple line wins.  0:i;l;h;h;g\#i;h;h;h;g\#a;h;g;l;i\#R\#ahhh\#02112031\#MV\#100\#MT\#1\#MG\#30\#R\#ahhh\#02112131\#MV\#100\#MT\#1\#MG\#30\#R\#ahh\#021221\#MV\#100\#MT\#1\#MG\#10\#

0: Defines the first event (Base Game)  
i;l;h;h;g\#i;h;h;h;g\#a;h;g;l;i: Are the symbols which landed split into rows by the \# sign.

### 2.1 Wins

R\#ahhh\#02112031\#MV\#100\#MT\#1\#MG\#30 R\#ahhh\#02112131\#MV\#100\#MT\#1\#MG\#30   
R\#ahh\#021221\#MV\#100\#MT\#1\#MG\#10

Ahhh, ahhh and ahh are the symbols making up the win.  
02112031, 02112131, 021221 are the symbol locations. Col and row concatenated together.

MV\#100 represents the wager amount of 100\.  
MT\#1 is the multiplier of 1\.  
MG\#30, MG\#30 and MG\#10 are the winning amounts for each line. 30, 30 and 10 respectively giving a total win amount of 70\.

y;q\#MV\#10\#MT\#1\#MG\#0\#24:w;q;q;y;y;q;q;q;y;q;q;y;q;q;q;q;q;y;q;q;y;y;q;q;q;q;q;y;q\#MV\#10\#MT\#1\#MG\#0\#25:s;q;q;y;y;q;q;q;y;q;q;y;q;q;q;q;q;y;q;q;y;y;q;q;q;q;q;y;q\#MV\#10\#MT\#1\#MG\#0\#26:s;q;q;y;y;q;q;q;y;q;q;y;q;q;q;q;q;y;q;q;y;y;q;q;q;q;q;y;q\#R\#s\#00\#MV\#10\#MT\#1\#MG\#100\#27:w;q;q;y;y;q;q;q;y;q;q;y;q;q;q;q;q;y;q;q;y;y;q;q;q;q;q;y;q\#R\#q\#201902801001807060140220260250130150230240901601201050\#MV\#10\#MT\#1\#MG\#380\#  
0:r;m;e;f;a\#i;f;e;n;k\#i;h;e;j;o\#MV\#10\#MT\#1\#MG\#0\# represents the base game, using the structure previously explained.

Each event is split using the following separator “\#{eventNumber}:”.  
Example.  
\#0: First Event, Base Game  
\#1: Second Event, Bonus Spins round 1  
\#2: Third Event Event, Bonus Spins round 2

### 3.1 Breaking down the first BonusSpin Event.

\#1:y;y;q;y;y;y;y;y;y;y;y;y;y;y;y;y;y;y;y;q;y;y;y;y;y;y;y;y;q\#MV\#10\#MT\#1\#MG\#0

Y;y;q;y;y;y;y;y;y;y;y;y;y;y;y;y;y;y;y;q;y;y;y;y;y;y;y;y;q represent the symbols on the display.

#### No Win

\#MV\#10\#MT\#1\#MG\#0

MV\#10 represents the wager amount of 10\.  
MT\#1 is the multiplier of 1\.  
MG\#0 indicates the win amount of 0\.

### 3.2 Jackpot Win

\#26:s;q;q;y;y;q;q;q;y;q;q;y;q;q;q;q;q;y;q;q;y;y;q;q;q;q;q;y;q\#R\#s\#00\#MV\#10\#MT\#1\#MG\#100 

\#26: indicates event 26, Bonusspin number 25\.

s;q;q;y;y;q;q;q;y;q;q;y;q;q;q;q;q;y;q;q;y;y;q;q;q;q;q;y represents the display symbols.

R\#s\#00\#MV\#10\#MT\#1\#MG\#100 represents the win.  
The symbol “**s”** is the mini jackpot symbol.  
MV\#10 A value of 10 was wagered.  
MT\#1 The multiplier has been set to 1\.  
MG\#100 The win amount is 100\.
